items.title: Intel (INTC) Enters Trusted AI Standards as Enterprise Infrastructure Role Grows
items.summary: Intel (NasdaqGS: INTC) was featured at ASUS AI Tech 2026, where ASUS expanded its AI infrastructure ecosystem using Intel technologies for cloud and industrial edge solutions. The Linux Foundation adopted the TRACE open specification for trusted AI execution, with Intel as a key contributor to the framework for secure and verifiable AI workloads. These developments highlight Intel’s role in enterprise AI adoption across data center and edge infrastructure, as well as in setting governance...

items.title: Intel’s AI Tailwinds Are Real. Mizuho Cut the Target Anyway.
items.summary: On September 3, Mizuho lowered the price target on Intel Corporation (NASDAQ:INTC) to $92 from $109. Mizuho’s note reads more bullish on INTC’s business than the price target suggests, but the firm is stopping short of turning bullish. items.title: Marvell Stock Had A Huge Year And Still Sits Well Below Its High
items.summary: Marvell Technology (MRVL) stock returned 235.9% over the past year, climbing from $62.18 to $208.83. The company kept raising what it expects to sell, and buyers repriced it each time. Then the shares pulled back, and they now sit well below their best.
